title: A limit of constructibly closed subsets of spectral spaces along spectral maps is quasi-compact
statement: Let $(I,\le)$ be a preordered set (a set with a reflexive and transitive relation $\le$; no directedness is assumed), let $(X_i)_{i\in I}$ be spectral spaces [def-weil-spectral-space] and for $i\le i'$ let $f_{ii'}:X_{i'}\to X_i$ be spectral maps (continuous, with $f_{ii'}^{-1}(W)$ quasi-compact for every quasi-compact open $W\subseteq X_i$), with $f_{ii}=\mathrm{id}$ and $f_{ii'}\circ f_{i'i''}=f_{ii''}$ for $i\le i'\le i''$. Let $X$ be a topological space with continuous maps $p_i:X\to X_i$, $f_{ii'}\circ p_{i'}=p_i$, which is a limit of the system in the category of topological spaces (the map $x\mapsto(p_i(x))_i$ is a bijection of $X$ onto $\{(x_i)\in\prod_iX_i: f_{ii'}(x_{i'})=x_i\text{ for }i\le i'\}$ and the topology of $X$ is the coarsest for which all $p_i$ are continuous). For each $i\in I$ let $Z_i\subseteq X_i$ be a subset which is closed in the constructible topology of $X_i$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-topology] (the topology on the set $X_i$ with subbase the quasi-compact open subsets of $X_i$ and their complements), such that $f_{ii'}(Z_{i'})\subseteq Z_i$ for all $i\le i'$. Then the subset $Z=\{x\in X: p_i(x)\in Z_i\text{ for all }i\in I\}$ of $X$ is quasi-compact in the topology induced from $X$: every covering of $Z$ by subsets open in $Z$ has a finite subcovering. In particular (taking $Z_i=X_i$ for all $i$) $X$ is quasi-compact.

source.place: Topology, Lemma Tag 0A2V (label lemma-inverse-limit-spectral-spaces-quasi-compact, line 4779), parts (1) and (2), stated there for a diagram over any category; here for an inverse system over a preordered set. Stacks' limit lim Z_i (in topological spaces, of the subspaces Z_i) is the subspace Z of X: both are the compatible families with all components in the Z_i, with the coarsest topology making the maps to the X_i continuous. Stacks' proof uses Lemmas 0901 (lemma-constructible-hausdorff-quasi-compact), 005C (lemma-closed-in-quasi-compact), 08ZV (lemma-inverse-limit-quasi-compact) and the image of a quasi-compact space
